publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for root-user lifecycle routes.
Cross-feature seam for root-user sign-in and lifecycle state reads.
Cross-feature seam for browser bootstrap summaries of the current root user.
Shared type describing root-user auth eligibility state.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing root-user normalization, lifecycle, or soft-delete semantics can break authentication and authorization features that depend on stable operator identity facts.
Changing exported auth-state or browser-summary seams can break rootAuth and rootRoles integration.
